page.layout: One page of handwriting only: a scribbled flourish at the top, then handwritten dates and a flourish below. No printed text.
page.notes: Handwritten manuscript annotations, not printed text, so not transcribed: a dense scribbled flourish at the top; "4th July 1808" in ink script; a large looped flourish; "Gr. from D. 7 Exp" or similar, a partly legible ink line; "April 4th 1815" in ink script at the bottom. Also scattered specks and stains on the page. Excluded as handwriting, not print.
